boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named, map-listed destinations along practical corridors around FAU’s Boca Raton campus, each paired with one sourced reason to go.

cards.title: Study Beside the Lake
cards.subtitle: NW Spanish River Boulevard — public library workspace
cards.notes: Bring reading or coursework for a daytime study session; check the library page before leaving for current in-person hours.
cards.short_summary: A municipal library stop with evening weekday hours near FAU’s northern side.
cards.evidence_claim: The City lists Spanish River Library at 1501 NW Spanish River Boulevard and reports in-person hours until 8 p.m. Monday through Thursday.
cards.source_title: Locations and Hours | Boca Raton Public Library
cards.access_notes: Current city listing: Monday–Thursday 9 a.m.–8 p.m.; Friday–Sunday 9 a.m.–5 p.m.

cards.title: Follow a StoryWalk Trail
cards.subtitle: NW 15th Street — accessible preserve path
cards.notes: Take the short accessible trail through pine flatwoods and scrub, reading the rotating StoryWalk panels along the route.
cards.short_summary: A compact nature-and-reading break on the corridor immediately south of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The City places Serenoa Glade Preserve at 1101 NW 15th Street and documents a 0.3-mile ADA-accessible trail with a rotating StoryWalk.
cards.source_title: Serenoa Glade Preserve | Boca Raton, FL
cards.access_notes: Open 8 a.m. to sunset; parking is shared with George Snow Park.

cards.title: Walk an Ancient-Dune Landscape
cards.subtitle: West Camino Real — scrub-habitat preserve
cards.notes: Walk the 0.9-mile trail and look for exposed white sand and scrub plants; observe wildlife without handling or feeding it.
cards.short_summary: A trail through conserved Florida scrub on the Camino Real corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The City locates Blazing Star Preserve at 1751 West Camino Real and documents a 0.9-mile walking/biking trail through rare scrub habitat.
cards.source_title: Blazing Star Preserve | Boca Raton, FL
cards.access_notes: Open 8 a.m. to sunset; the official page lists five parking spaces.

cards.title: Choose a First-Come Court
cards.subtitle: St. Andrews Boulevard — public recreation stop
cards.notes: Bring a ball or racquet and use an open court when it is not reserved; basketball and tennis lighting is available Monday–Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A multi-court park along the St. Andrews Boulevard corridor west of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The City lists University Woodlands Park at 2501 St. Andrews and says its athletic courts are available first come, first served when not permitted.
cards.source_title: University Woodlands Park | Boca Raton, FL
cards.access_notes: Monday–Saturday 8 a.m.–11 p.m.; Sunday 8 a.m.–sunset. Permitted activities take priority.

cards.title: Loop the Canal-Side Trail
cards.subtitle: SW 18th Street — waterfront recreation corridor
cards.notes: Walk or bike the 0.61-mile trail beside the waterway, then use the outdoor fitness equipment or an available court.
cards.short_summary: A waterfront activity stop connecting SW 18th Street with the El Rio Canal.
cards.evidence_claim: The City places Hillsboro El Rio Park South at 190 SW 18th Street and lists a 0.61-mile walking/biking trail, waterway and outdoor fitness equipment.
cards.source_title: Hillsboro El Rio Park South | Boca Raton, FL
cards.access_notes: Open 8 a.m. to sunset; courts and other amenities may be occupied.

cards.title: Make It a Swim Stop
cards.subtitle: NW 8th Street — park-and-pool corridor
cards.notes: Check the aquatic schedule before heading over, then pair a pool visit with time in the surrounding 12.7-acre city park.
cards.short_summary: A municipal park with an aquatic facility on NW 8th Street near campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The current City parks-and-facilities guide identifies Meadows Park at 1300 NW 8th Street as a 12.7-acre site with an aquatic facility.
cards.source_title: Parks and Facilities | City of Boca Raton
cards.access_notes: Pool programs and operating hours can change; consult the City aquatic schedule before visiting.

cards.title: Browse an Indoor Retail Circuit
cards.subtitle: Glades Road — enclosed shopping destination
cards.notes: Use the official directory to plan a weather-sheltered browsing loop, and confirm individual store hours before setting out.
cards.short_summary: An indoor shopping stop on the Glades Road corridor west of FAU.
cards.evidence_claim: Simon’s official property page identifies Town Center at Boca Raton as an indoor shopping center and provides its Boca Raton address and directions.
cards.source_title: About Town Center at Boca Raton®
cards.access_notes: Shopping-center and individual tenant hours may differ; verify the official directory before visiting.

cards.title: Walk the Plaza Real Spine
cards.subtitle: Plaza Real — outdoor downtown corridor
cards.notes: Start at the central green and walk the outdoor complex, using the official property map to identify public-facing destinations.
cards.short_summary: A landscaped outdoor complex organized along downtown Boca Raton’s Plaza Real.
cards.evidence_claim: Mizner Park’s official visitor page lists the property at 327 Plaza Real and confirms that a city park runs through the outdoor mall.
cards.access_notes: Property hours are listed as Monday–Saturday 11 a.m.–9 p.m. and Sunday noon–6 p.m.; tenant hours vary.

cards.title: See the Rehabilitation Facility
cards.subtitle: North Ocean Boulevard — coastal education corridor
cards.notes: Time the visit for facility hours, then see the aquariums and sea-turtle rehabilitation area before walking the nature trail.
cards.short_summary: A coastal environmental-education stop east of campus on North Ocean Boulevard.
cards.evidence_claim: The City’s current facilities guide places Gumbo Limbo Nature Center at 1801 North Ocean Boulevard and lists aquariums, a sea-turtle rehabilitation facility and nature trails.
cards.source_title: Parks and Facilities | City of Boca Raton
cards.access_notes: Guide lists facility hours Monday–Saturday 9 a.m.–4 p.m., Sunday noon–4 p.m.; trails daily 7 a.m.–dusk.

cards.title: Pick a Recreation Zone
cards.subtitle: North State Road A1A — beach-park corridor
cards.notes: Choose one documented activity—nature trail, bird observation, sand volleyball or a picnic—and leave before the sunset closing.
cards.short_summary: A broad beach-park stop at the eastern end of the Spanish River corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The City locates Spanish River Park at 3001 North State Road A1A and lists nature trails, bird observation, picnic areas, a playground and sand volleyball.
cards.source_title: Spanish River Park | Boca Raton, FL
cards.access_notes: Open 8 a.m. to sunset; beach permits or activity-specific rules may apply.
